name: Lodesta awning mark

geometry.badgeBox: x 41-471, top y 66, valance attach y 380, scallop base y 446
geometry.notes: Valance depth, corner radius, and letter contrast are tuned so the silhouette and letter both survive a 16px favicon. Letter is optically centered between the solid-body center and the full-silhouette center, not centered in the body alone.

provenance: Vector geometry was rebuilt deterministically from the selected visual direction. PNG files are rasterized directly from the corresponding SVG files via sharp at 1024x1024. No font dependency or embedded raster image is used.
maskedContexts: This mark's scalloped lower edge is clipped by circular and squircle avatar masks (iOS/Android app icons, Slack, Google, GitHub org avatars). No circle-masked variant is currently checked in; generate one before shipping to any of those surfaces.
